name: OI-price divergence — short-covering rally fade (price up + OI down, short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: a rally NOT confirmed by new open_interest is fuelled by short-COVERING, not fresh long conviction — positions closing, not new money — so it fades. Signal: positive 4h return (price up) while open_interest is contracting (OI down) in a non-trending regime (low ADX so it is a range pop, not a real breakout). We short (direction -1) the unconfirmed rally; the other side is traders closing shorts (mechanical, price-insensitive) vs those who mistake the pop for a trend. Edge persists because OI/price confirmation is a positioning read most discretionary traders ignore. Hold ~0.25-0.5d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if OI is too noisy/aggregated at 4h (gaps, resets, cross-venue double-counting) so the divergence sign is unreliable — a PIT-honest single-venue OI series is required. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the fade underperforms same-bar momentum continuation (divergence adds nothing over just trading the move) or if edge vanishes once real taker fees hit the turnover.
catalyst: price rises while open interest falls in a calm regime — an unconfirmed short-covering rally to fade short.
